hook.say: From Alaska to Patagonia: how well do you know the Americas? Five questions, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: In which country is Machu Picchu?
questions.say: In which country is Mah-choo Peek-choo?
questions.fact: The Inca built it in the 1400s, about 2,430 meters up in the Andes.
questions.sayAnswer: Peru! The Inca built Mah-choo Peek-choo in the 1400s, about 2,430 meters up in the Andes.

questions.q: Which is the largest country in South America?
questions.fact: Brazil covers nearly half of the whole continent.
questions.sayAnswer: Brazil! It covers nearly half of the whole continent.

questions.q: What is the highest mountain in the Americas?
questions.fact: Aconcagua, in Argentina, is the highest peak anywhere outside Asia.
questions.sayAnswer: Ah-con-cah-gwa! This giant in Argentina is the highest peak anywhere outside Asia.

questions.q: Which South American country has English as its official language?
questions.fact: Guyana was a British colony until 1966. Belize is in Central America.
questions.sayAnswer: Guy-anna! It was a British colony until 1966. And Belize is in Central America.

questions.q: Which of these countries does NOT border Brazil?
questions.fact: Brazil touches every South American country except Chile and Ecuador.
questions.sayAnswer: Chile! Brazil touches every country in South America, except Chile and Ecuador.
